decisions.reason: The particle therapy water phantom was only being released in Q1/2019, so no shortfall against aspirations can exist yet, and a niche strategic product in a growing segment would be carried on the firm's slack.

Small volume chambers are core dosimetry products with steady demand from small-field and stereotactic QA, and nothing signals results below aspiration, so there is no reason to search for alternatives.
Although it overlaps with Product B, low-cost ionization chamber variants add to a complete portfolio and calibration business, and the absence of any problem signal supports keeping it.
A standard clinical chamber is a long-lived workhorse product with predictable demand that likely meets aspirations, consistent with the firm's established dosimetry business.
Relative dosimetry chambers pair with the firm's water phantoms and scanning systems, so complementary sales likely sustain satisfactory performance.
Thimble chambers are staple reference instruments, and with no indication of underperformance a mature firm with slack would retain it.
